messages.subject: [pomp-announce] pomp version 0.38-5 released
messages.body_plain:
Dear pomp users,

I've just submitted version pomp 0.38-5 to CRAN.  Source code and binaries should become available on the mirrors over the next few days.  This release contains minor improvements to the 
functionality of 'pfilter' and 'spect'.  See the NEWS file for details.

All the best,

Aaron

-- 
Aaron A. King, Ph.D.
Ecology & Evolutionary Biology
Mathematics
Center for the Study of Complex Systems
University of Michigan
